persona: Mairi from Inverness works as a Route Manager for the North Coast 500 tourism collective. She coordinates with Highland Council rangers and local estates to manage visitor pressure, dirty camping, single-track roads, passing places, and local concerns during the tourist season. Her role requires balancing visitor access with the everyday realities of local crofters and livestock on narrow roads.
task: Schedule the A835 NC500 checkpoint visit with Highland Council rangers on the planned date and include the livestock-delay contingency note in the calendar description.
